'''Zinethium''' was a rare and deadly material.

[[File:Zinethium.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A chunk of zinethium]]

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], a team of thieves attacked the [[class-3 toxic weapons dump]] on [[Nyara]] to retrieve a chunk of zinethium. Several of them [[Death/Legends|died]] in the attempt, but the surviving members escaped the planet under fire with the zinethium.

The leader of the team met with [[Nom Anor]] on the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] and turned over the chunk to him.
